role.title: DEMO ONLY - Production Support Engineer L2

criteria.question: Describe a specific service incident and the commands you used.
Explain a query you used to investigate a production issue.
What was your personal role during an incident and its follow-up?
Which support task did you automate and how did you validate it?
Describe your hands-on container troubleshooting experience.

profiles.name: Alex Morgan
profiles.text:
FICTIONAL DEMONSTRATION RESUME - DEMO-101 - Alex Morgan
Not a real applicant. For manager demonstration only.
Target: Production Support Engineer
Experience: Supported a fictional retail payments service.
Used Linux logs and service commands to investigate failed requests.
Used SQL queries to trace transaction reconciliation issues.
Owned incident management coordination for fictional service interruptions.
Built Python scripts to summarize recurring support alerts.
Inspected Docker container logs and restarted a test service.
Interview follow-up: confirm personal contribution, depth and scope.
